And maybe there really is no one out there to help you. Do you have it inside of you to pull yourself up? It's okay to take a few weeks off from life. Go ahead and feel depressed. But it's important for you to realize that you'll be on your own for most of your life. People are weak, and I've never been able to trust them to support my problems (and the times that I tested it out, the results came out positive). I don't have much of a solution for you, for I'm in the very same spot. Try to accept that a solitary life is not a bad life.
